title: Igokea sweep Bosna to defend Division I title
description: FINALIgokea - Bosna S. 85-78 Igokea defended their Division I title as they swept Bosna in the championship series. Igokea outrebounded Bosna 40-27 including a 20-5 advantage in offensive rebounds. American point guard Bryce Jones (183-1994, college: Murray St.) orchestrated the victory with a double-double by scoring 13 points, 5 rebounds and 11 assists. Serbian Dragan Milosavljevic (198-1989) contributed with 17 points and 9 rebounds for the winners. Jones is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. American forward Jarrod West (182-1999, college: Louisville) replied with 13 points and 5 assists and the former international forward Haris Delalic (203-1994, agency: PEPI SPORT) added 14 points and 5 rebounds in the effort for Bosna.
